patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts for 'Featured projects' and 'Blog' sections, combining different card sizes and orientations to create visual interest.
Dominant use of extremely large, bold sans-serif typography for primary headings, creating a strong visual hierarchy and modern aesthetic.
High-contrast black and white base palette, punctuated by a single vibrant orange accent color used sparingly for calls-to-action and key interactive elements.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll. The hero video background exhibits a gentle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text.
Full-width sections with alternating dark and light backgrounds, creating clear visual separation and a sense of progression down the page.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation remains at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to main links.
Scroll-triggered animations (likely using css-keyframes) are applied to content blocks, causing them to subtly fade in and slide upwards as they become visible in the viewport.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background that appears to have a fixed or slow-moving parallax effect, allowing overlaying text to scroll over it.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter-weight sans-serif body text and compact uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and some image cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a tighter grid for project and blog cards.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated blend of bold, oversized typography and dynamic scroll-triggered motion. The full-bleed video hero with a subtle parallax effect and the persistent circular element on the right edge create a premium, interactive experience that feels highly polished and distinctive.
